scripts.build: mkdir -p build && find . -maxdepth 1 -name '*-tool' | while read tool; do echo "Building $tool..."; mkdir -p "build/$tool"; npx uglify-js "$tool/script.js" -m -c -o "build/$tool/script.min.js" 2>/dev/null; npx postcss "$tool/styles.css" -o "build/$tool/styles.min.css" --use cssnano --no-map 2>/dev/null; cp "$tool/index.html" "build/$tool/index.html"; cp -r "$tool/images" "build/$tool/images" 2>/dev/null; sed -i '' -e 's/script.js/script.min.js/g' -e 's/styles.css/styles.min.css/g' "build/$tool/index.html"; done && cp index.html build/
